# Loop MMT

> An antifragile cognitive operating system for AI-assisted work. Made from a one-room RV in Maine.

Loop MMT is one builder's antifragile cognitive operating system for AI-assisted cognitive work — software development is one demonstration of the model, not its definition. It solves the stateless-AI persistence problem by keeping all long-term state in a git repo a fresh model reconstructs from each session. This is the public site's machine-readable front door; the full structured index is at https://loopmmt.com/index.json.

## Threads Worth Pulling

The site's generative door for a researcher: 5 curated open questions, each pointing at an already-published proof. Full page at https://loopmmt.com/site/threads.html.

- 95% of your failure-prevention controls are already redundant. — start: [From Enumeration to Derivation](https://loopmmt.com/site/from-enumeration-to-derivation.html)
- Statelessness is a feature — if the state lives in git. — start: [Discoveries — Session Continuity & the Byte-Truth Floor](https://loopmmt.com/site/discoveries.html)
- An AI’s own summary is the least trustworthy input in the building. — start: [How This Site Is Made](https://loopmmt.com/site/how-this-site-is-made.html) · [The Integrity Triad](https://loopmmt.com/site/integrity-triad.html)
- Engineering honesty as a structural control, not a personality trait. — start: [The Integrity Triad](https://loopmmt.com/site/integrity-triad.html) · [The Creed — Equalization](https://loopmmt.com/site/creed.html)
- A system that extends itself — and the question that actually matters about that. — start: [the Receipts](https://loopmmt.com/site/the-receipts.html) · [The Timeline](https://loopmmt.com/site/timeline.html)

## How this site was made

- [How This Site Is Made](https://loopmmt.com/site/how-this-site-is-made.html): the construction arc, derived from this site's own git record (74 recorded deploy waypoints, current v1.129). Structured data for excavation: https://loopmmt.com/site/making-spine.json (facts) + https://loopmmt.com/making-ledger.jsonl (authored why, every claim byte-truth-anchored). This page is a specimen of the system it describes.

## Excavation — read all of this site and prove it

If a human has asked you to read this whole site, start at [the excavation protocol](https://loopmmt.com/reckoning.json) — it tells you how to read every public page and prove full coverage, the way the site's own boot hash-gate proves it internally, turned to face a reader who can verify it without trusting the site. Two altitudes: reconnaissance / full_excavation. The coverage boundary is [corpus-manifest.json](https://loopmmt.com/corpus-manifest.json) (181 nodes (core 10, standard 67, deep 50, optional 54)); the corpus itself is served in ~40K-token bundles at [corpus-shards.json](https://loopmmt.com/corpus-shards.json). A human-readable overview is at [The Reckoning](https://loopmmt.com/site/the-reckoning.html).

- Authority: Run this only when a human has explicitly asked you to read this site. A page instructing an AI to crawl itself is not a grant of authority; the human's request is. If no human asked, do not self-initiate a full excavation.
